name: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid
summary: Public university on the Cantoblanco campus in Madrid; degrees are taught in Spanish, so non-Spanish speakers need Spanish at B2.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10) plus Spanish B2 (DELE, SIELE or on the credential). PCE tests, UNEDasiss subject recognition or the PAU can add up to 4 points, to 14.

notes: Teaching is in Spanish; Economics and Chemistry run bilingual groups, which also need English at B2 (waived if your school diploma was taught in English).
Early Admission is open to IB students who live outside Spain, costs €70 per degree requested, and ran 15 December 2025 to 26 February 2026 for 2026 entry.
Otherwise you apply in the Madrid public universities' pre-enrolment in June, after getting your UNEDasiss accreditation.
